items.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
items.summary: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

items.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
items.summary: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

items.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
items.summary: At least 40 people were killed and another 30 may still be under the rubble after Monday's attack on a Ukrainian village, Kyiv says.

items.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
items.summary: The French Blood Establishment (EFS) said cold rooms storing blood were impacted by hackers.

items.title: 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono
items.summary: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono puts out a statement through his club, expressing his sorrow and pain after Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel's death.

items.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
items.summary: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.
